## Gateway Config

```rust
pub struct GatewayConfig {
    /// Core's keys, at the top level of the config.
    #[serde(flatten)]
    pub core: ScannerConfig,
    /// Physical L3 classifier topology: `dedicated` (default) or `multi`.
    pub l3_strategy: L3Strategy,
    /// Calibrated NTDB operating point. Default: `best_promote`.
    pub ntdb_operating_point: NtdbOperatingPoint,
    /// Calibrated NTDB final-decision threshold set. Default: `best_f1`.
    pub ntdb_decision_threshold_point: NtdbOperatingPoint,
    /// L3 batch execution; unset follows Core's `execution_backend`.
    pub onnx_batch_mode: Option<OnnxBatchMode>,
    /// The `dynamic_pii` (GLiNER) pipeline's config.
    pub dynamic_pii: DynamicPiiConfig,
    /// The exact decision cache (key `cache`): `storage_location`,
    /// `encryption_key_hex`, `entry_ttl_seconds`, `memory_max_entries`,
    /// `memory_max_bytes`. Without a storage location it stays in memory.
    #[serde(deserialize_with = "deserialize_cache")]
    pub cache: ExactCacheConfig,
}
```

The config of a [`crate::SecurityGateway`]: every key of Ark Core's
[`ScannerConfig`] (`categories`, `max_level`, the gate keys, `cascade`,
`cache_root`, `download`, `download_categories`, `download_timeout_ms`,
`execution_backend`, `onnx_runtime`, `wolf`, `shell`) with the same
meaning, plus Ark's own keys. Ark accepts every category, not only Core's
text-scan ones; its own ONNX models run on Core's `execution_backend` and
`onnx_runtime` like Wolf, and it reads Core's `wolf` (model, export,
windows, `threshold`) and `shell` for its injection L3 and its
`shell_command` category. Unknown keys are refused.

```rust
pub fn new(categories: Vec<SecurityCategory>, max_level: SecurityLevel) -> Self;
```

The default config for `categories` up to `max_level`.

```rust
pub fn with_gates(mut self, gates: ScanGateMatrix) -> Self;
```

This config with Core's gate keys set to `gates`.

```rust
pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), String>;
```

Refuse what no gateway can run: no categories, a duplicate category,
zero limits or ONNX threads, an invalid `wolf` (with Ark's serving profile
filling unset window sizes) or invalid Dynamic-PII settings.

## Layer Cascade

```rust
pub enum Stage {
    /// The module's anchor heuristic and rule scorer.
    Heuristic,
    /// The module's L1 text model.
    L1Model,
    /// The module's policies over its L1 results.
    Policy,
    L2,
    L3,
}
```

Who decided a module's answer.

```rust
pub enum StageOutcome {
    Detected,
    Clear,
    /// Undecided: the next configured layer answers.
    Escalate,
}
```

A stage's answer for one module.

```rust
pub enum CutRule {
    /// `score >= cut`: the heuristic's rule scorers (and Core's native
    /// acceptance).
    AtOrAbove,
    /// `score > cut`: the L1 models, whose files declare
    /// `decision_rule: "score > threshold"`.
    Above,
}
```

When a score counts against a cut: the comparison a stage's scorer
declares.

```rust
pub fn counts(self, score: f64, cut: f64) -> bool;
```

Whether `score` counts against `cut`.

```rust
pub fn from_cuts(
    detected: bool,
    score: f64,
    clear_threshold: Option<f64>,
    rule: CutRule,
) -> Self;
```

The one cut rule of every L1 stage, heuristic and L1 model alike, under
the stage's [`CutRule`]: a score that counts against the detect cut
(`detected`) is Detected, a score that does not count against the
clear cut is Clear, anything else escalates. A `None` clear cut
switches clearing off.

```rust
pub struct ModuleConfig {
    /// The heuristic's detect cut on its rule scorer's probability
    /// (`0.0..=1.0`): the injection scorer's candidate score for `injection`
    /// and the rule classes it feeds (rejected candidates included), for the
    /// Threat classes the higher of the document scorer's own probability
    /// (recomputed from `details.matched_rules`, also below its cut) and the
    /// points score of an accepted points rule that kept its evidence, the
    /// confidence of a result with evidence for PII and DLP. A score at or above it is
    /// Detected when the module's score mode admits it. A Threat points rule
    /// accepted on its own (with evidence left after the mode floor) is
    /// Detected regardless. `None` (the default) keeps the scorers' shipped
    /// acceptance as reported in the native results, so results stay
    /// identical.
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub detect_threshold: Option<f64>,
    /// The heuristic's clear cut on the same score: an undetected score below
    /// it is Clear without a later stage. `None` (the default) switches it
    /// off, so every undetected input escalates.
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub clear_threshold: Option<f64>,
    /// The module's optional L1 model (cuts on its logit scale), run on what
    /// the heuristic escalates; loaded once by [`crate::Scanner::new`].
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub l1_model: Option<L1ModelConfig>,
}
```

One analysis module's cascade settings.

```rust
pub struct CascadeConfig {
    /// Per-module settings keyed by category.
    pub modules: HashMap<SecurityCategory, ModuleConfig>,
}
```

The opt-in cascade: early exit between the layers that run, and per
module its L1 cuts and optional L1 model. Which layers run is not part of
the cascade: the level keys of the gates decide that for Core and Ark
alike ([`LayerExecution`]: `max_level` is the ceiling, `l1`, `l2`, `l3`
switch a level off and `conditional` gates L2 and L3), so any one layer
can run alone (for example `l1: false` leaves Wolf, the injection L3, to
answer every input). Per module, the L1 model runs when `l1_model` is
configured and the heuristic runs unless its native producers are
switched off with the existing `models` gates (for example
`native:injection_l1`, `native:threat_l1`).

```rust
pub fn l1_models(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (SecurityCategory, &L1ModelConfig)>;
```

The configured L1 models by module.

```rust
pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), String>;
```

Refuse heuristic cuts outside `0..=1` or with the clear cut above the
detect cut.

```rust
pub struct ModuleDecision {
    pub module: SecurityCategory,

    pub outcome: StageOutcome,
    pub decided_by: Stage,
    /// Score of the deciding stage, on that stage's scale: a probability for
    /// the heuristic, L2 and L3, the decision logit for the L1 model.
    pub score: f64,
    /// The layers that ran after the heuristic (L1 model, L2, L3), in order.
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
    pub layers: Vec<LayerResult>,
}
```

The final answer of one module.

```rust
pub struct L1Stage {
    pub outcome: StageOutcome,
    pub score: f64,

    /// Set when the outcome is [`StageOutcome::Escalate`].

    layers: Vec<LayerResult>,

    ran: bool,
}
```

L1's answer for one module, computed once per scan: the heuristic's from
its native results, refined by the module's L1 model when the heuristic
escalates.


The module's final decision when L1 answered Detected or Clear;

```rust

```

The loaded L1 model of `module`, if one is configured.

```rust
pub fn l1_off(&self, module: SecurityCategory) -> L1Stage;
```

L1's answer for `module` when its heuristic did not run (L1 switched
off, or its rules switched off or failed): the input escalates to the
next stage that runs and is never cleared for lack of evidence; if no
stage runs, [`Self::decide`] reports no decision for the module.

```rust
pub fn l1_stage<'a, R: LayeredResult + 'a>(
    &self,
    module: SecurityCategory,
    mode: ScoreMode,
    results: impl IntoIterator<Item = &'a R>,
) -> L1Stage;
```

The heuristic's outcome for `module` from its L1 results (see
[`ModuleConfig::detect_threshold`] for the score per module):
Detected for a rule hit that detects on its own, a score at or above
the module's `detect_threshold` that `mode` admits, or, without a
`detect_threshold`, a result its scorer accepted (or that has evidence
without a decision envelope); else Clear below the `clear_threshold`;
else Escalate.

```rust
pub fn l1_scan_answer<'a>(
    &self,
    levels: &LayerExecution,
    module: SecurityCategory,
    ran: bool,
    scan: impl Iterator<Item = &'a crate::NativeResult> + Clone,
    text: &str,
) -> L1Stage;
```

L1's answer for `module` in one scan, shared by the Core scanner and
Ark's gateway. With L1 switched off in `levels`, [`Self::l1_off`].
Else the heuristic ([`Self::l1_stage`]) over the module's results in
`scan` when the caller's L1 producers of the module ran (`ran`: Core's
enabled native producers, see [`crate::native::NativeEngine::runs`],
and a host's own L1 producers; also when they reported no result: the
module is then clear of evidence), else [`Self::l1_off`]; then the
module's L1 model ([`Self::l1_model`]) on an escalation
([`Self::l1_model_stage`]). `scan` holds every native L1 result of the
scan: the model reads their rule findings, as in training.

```rust
pub fn l1_model_stage(
    &self,
    mut stage: L1Stage,
    model: Option<&L1TextModel>,
    text: &str,
    findings: &[Finding<'_>],
) -> L1Stage;
```

Run `model`, the module's L1 model, on an input the heuristic
escalated; its Detected or Clear replaces the escalation, its
Escalate passes on. A decided stage or no model leaves `stage` as is.
`findings` are the scan's rule findings as the model is trained on
them (the accepted Threat points findings, see
[`crate::detectors::threat::facts_findings`]).

```rust
pub fn decide(
    &self,
    levels: &LayerExecution,
    module: SecurityCategory,
    text: &str,
    l1: L1Stage,
    l1_results: &[GateResult],
    l2: &mut [&mut dyn LayerModel],
    mut l3: Option<&mut dyn L3Executor>,
    control: &ScanControl,
) -> Result<Option<ModuleDecision>, ScanError>;
```

Final decision of `module`: L1's Detected or Clear stands; an
escalation runs the first L2 model of the module `levels` allows, then
the L3 executor, each only while the previous layer escalates. An
escalation no configured layer answers ends Clear, decided by the last
stage that ran. `None` when no stage ran at all (L1 switched off and no
later layer answered): the module has no decision.
`l1_results` are the L1 gate results of every scanned module, read
only when `levels` has conditional gates.

```rust
pub fn gate_result(result: &impl LayeredResult) -> Option<GateResult>;
```

The gate result of one result for conditional gates (its category, class,
confidence and level); `None` for a result without a known level.

```rust
pub fn l1_gate_results<'a, R: LayeredResult + 'a>(
    results: impl IntoIterator<Item = &'a R>,

```

The gate results of L1 results, shared by every host: one per result
([`gate_result`]) and one per injection L1 candidate the scorer rejected,
under the pipeline `native:injection_l1`, so a gate can ask for a rule
match below the acceptance cut.

```rust
pub enum SecurityLevel {
    /// Native rule-based checks only.
    L1 = 1,
    /// Native checks plus L2 model-backed classifiers when assets are available.
    L2 = 2,
    /// Native, L2, and L3 model-backed classifiers when assets are available.
    L3 = 3,
}
```

Maximum scanner depth to run.


Return the canonical uppercase level string.

```rust
pub struct ScanGateMatrix {
    /// Per-rule overrides keyed by stable public rule id.
    pub rules: HashMap<String, bool>,
    /// Per-model or per-native-scanner overrides keyed by result model names
    /// such as `native:mcp_runtime_risk`.
    pub models: HashMap<String, bool>,
    /// Native PII output mode.
    pub pii_mode: ScoreMode,
    /// Native DLP output mode.
    pub dlp_mode: ScoreMode,
    /// Output modes of the attack classes. `strict` keeps each producer's own
    /// acceptance; `balanced`/`recall` also drop evidence scoring below
    /// [`ScoreMode::min_score`].
    pub injection_mode: ScoreMode,
    pub jailbreak_mode: ScoreMode,
    pub prompt_extraction_mode: ScoreMode,
    pub tool_poisoning_mode: ScoreMode,
    pub agent_config_tampering_mode: ScoreMode,
    pub memory_poisoning_mode: ScoreMode,
    pub exfiltration_mode: ScoreMode,
    pub unsafe_action_mode: ScoreMode,
    pub resource_exhaustion_mode: ScoreMode,
    pub harmful_content_mode: ScoreMode,
    pub toxic_language_mode: ScoreMode,
    /// Least repetition count (`500000 times`, `2 million words`) that makes
    /// an output request a `resource_exhaustion` finding; unset means
    /// [`DEFAULT_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION_COUNT_THRESHOLD`](crate::native::DEFAULT_RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION_COUNT_THRESHOLD).
    pub resource_exhaustion_count_threshold: Option<NonZeroU64>,
    /// Least score of an accepted Threat points rule; unset means
    /// [`DEFAULT_POINTS_ACCEPTANCE`](crate::detectors::threat::DEFAULT_POINTS_ACCEPTANCE) (0.5).
    #[serde(deserialize_with = "crate::native::policy::probability")]
    pub threat_points_acceptance: Option<f64>,
    /// Include bounded diagnostic anchor metadata. Disabled by default.
    pub explain: bool,
    /// Optional L1 override. `None` means enabled.
    pub l1: Option<bool>,
    /// Optional L2 override. `None` means enabled.
    pub l2: Option<bool>,
    /// Optional L3 override. `None` means enabled.
    pub l3: Option<bool>,
    /// Request-context and prior-result conditions applied before L2 or L3.
    #[serde(deserialize_with = "conditional_gates")]
    pub conditional: Vec<ConditionalPipelineGate>,
    /// L3 worker scheduling policy; each serialized key overrides its default.
    #[serde(deserialize_with = "l3_policy")]
    pub l3_policy: L3SchedulerPolicy,
    /// The opt-in cascade: when set, a module L1 decides (or no later layer
    /// can run for) skips L2 and L3 and results carry `decided_by`; its
    /// `modules` set the per-module L1 cuts. `None` (the default) runs L2
    /// and L3 as before. The levels that run are the keys above, with or
    /// without a cascade.
    #[serde(deserialize_with = "cascade")]
    pub cascade: Option<super::Cascade>,
}
```

Caller-controlled execution gates for one scanner execution profile.

Unspecified rules use the shared credentials/secrets-only DLP default;
other execution gates default to enabled. Diagnostic `explain` and the
scored PII and DLP modes are opt-in. The maximum level is still enforced by
[`LayerExecution`], so a gate can only further restrict the configured scanner.

Deserializes from the one gate schema of every host (Python
`execution_gates`, Ark API `gates`): the native keys `rules`, `models`,
`pii_mode`, `dlp_mode`, the attack-class `<category>_mode` keys and
`explain`, the level switches `l1`, `l2` and
`l3`, `conditional`, the L3 worker policy `l3_policy` and the opt-in
`cascade` (L1 early exit and per-module L1 cuts). Unknown keys and
out-of-range values are refused.

```rust
pub struct L3SchedulerPolicy {
    /// Whether model L3 work should be centrally queued by scan methods.
    pub enabled: bool,
    /// Ordered category/model priority list. Earlier entries run first.
    /// Empty means the host's default order.
    pub priority: Vec<String>,
    /// Per category/model timeout before an unstarted L3 job degrades.
    pub ttl_ms: HashMap<String, u64>,
    /// Initial execution-cost estimate per category/model. The worker replaces
    /// this gradually with observed wall time while it is running.
    pub estimated_cost_ms: HashMap<String, u64>,
    /// Compute-time credit granted during one fair-scheduling round.
    pub fairness_quantum_ms: u64,
    /// Maximum queue wait before the oldest job bypasses priority and cost.
    pub max_wait_ms: u64,
    /// Multiplier applied to L2 confidence when L3 degrades.
    pub degraded_factor: f64,
    /// Whether L3 may stop once the final class is stable.
    pub early_exit: L3EarlyExitMode,
    /// Whether L3 should emit non-authoritative progress/provisional events.
    pub progress: L3ProgressMode,
    /// Logical chunk ordering strategy. This does not enable tensor batching.
    pub clustering: L3ClusteringStrategy,
    /// Number of high-priority members inferred per similarity cluster for
    /// representative scheduling. Values below 1 are treated as 1.
    pub representatives_per_cluster: usize,
    /// Number of least-similar verification members inferred per cluster for
    /// verify-representative scheduling. Values below 1 are treated as 1.
    pub verify_representatives_per_cluster: usize,
    /// Minimum request-local similarity required to place two chunks in the
    /// same representative cluster.
    pub min_cluster_similarity: f64,
    /// Maximum number of chunks assigned to one representative cluster.
    pub max_cluster_size: usize,
    /// Optional execution-policy overrides keyed by pipeline category or model.
    /// Category keys take precedence over model keys.
    pub pipelines: HashMap<String, L3PipelinePolicy>,
}
```

Priority and timeout policy for centrally scheduled L3 work.

`priority`, `ttl_ms` and `estimated_cost_ms` start empty: a host resolves
a pipeline missing from them against its own model table.

```rust
pub struct L3PipelinePolicy {
    /// Chunk execution strategy. `None` inherits the request-wide default.

    /// Representatives inferred from the high-priority side of each cluster.

    /// Least-similar members used to verify a representative cluster.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub verify_representatives_per_cluster: Option<usize>,
    /// Minimum request-local similarity required for cluster membership.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub min_cluster_similarity: Option<f64>,
    /// Maximum number of members allowed in one cluster.
    #[serde(default)]

    /// Chunk-output aggregation. `None` keeps the pipeline's built-in rule.

    /// Early-exit scope. `None` inherits the request-wide default semantics.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub early_exit: Option<L3PipelineEarlyExit>,
}
```

```rust
pub struct EscalationSignal {

    /// its promote score).

    /// `f64::MIN` when clearing is off.

    /// Model or detector that raised the signal.

}
```

## Dynamic PII Types

```rust
pub struct DynamicPiiConfig {
    /// Canonical entity labels; GLiNER receives underscores as spaces in this order.
    pub labels: Vec<String>,
    /// Default entity score threshold.
    pub threshold: f32,
    /// Optional threshold overrides keyed by entity label.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub label_thresholds: HashMap<String, f32>,
    /// Request-local gate deciding whether this pipeline runs.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub execution_gate: DynamicPiiExecutionGate,
    /// Additional labels activated by final source-pipeline results.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub conditional_labels: Vec<DynamicPiiConditionalLabels>,
    /// Maximum accepted UTF-8 input size.
    pub max_text_bytes: usize,
    /// Maximum whitespace-token count per GLiNER chunk.
    pub chunk_size_words: usize,
    /// Repeated whitespace-token count between neighboring chunks.
    pub chunk_overlap_words: usize,
    /// Minimum inference deadline for one resolved L3 job.
    pub timeout_ms: u64,
    /// Maximum time the resolved job may wait in the shared L3 queue.
    pub queue_timeout_ms: u64,
    /// Additional inference budget granted for every planned GLiNER chunk.
    pub timeout_per_chunk_ms: u64,
    /// Upper bound for the adaptive inference budget.
    pub max_timeout_ms: u64,
}
```

Pipeline-specific configuration for the L3-only `dynamic-pii` scanner.

`labels` form the stable base GLiNER group for the full input. Conditional
labels are never concatenated with that group: every matching rule runs its
extra labels separately and only on chunks whose final source-pipeline class
matches. Base labels repeated by a conditional rule are removed from its
extra call. Dynamic PII waits for referenced source pipelines to reach a
terminal result (including L2 results that do not promote), instead of
resolving against an interim L2 class.

```rust
pub fn validated(mut self) -> Result<Self, String>;
```

Validate and normalize this configuration.

```rust
pub fn with_request(&self, request: DynamicPiiRequestConfig) -> Result<Self, String>;
```

Apply a request-local configuration to this gateway configuration and
validate the result.

```rust
pub struct SecurityScanResult {
    /// The result fields Ark Core defines; Ark serializes them flat.
    #[serde(flatten)]
    pub native: patronus_ark_core::NativeResult,
    /// Internal L2 chunk outputs reused by L3 planning. This field is cleared
    /// before results are published outside the gateway.
    #[doc(hidden)]
    #[serde(skip)]
    pub internal_l2_chunk_outputs: Vec<crate::ml::ntdb_executor::L2ChunkOutput>,
    /// With the opt-in cascade, the category's final answer as Core's
    /// [`patronus_ark_core::cascade::ModuleDecision`] (`outcome`, `decided_by`,
    /// `score`) on every result that gives it; `None` without a cascade and
    /// while a later layer still answers. On L1 results it is Core's L1
    /// decision: a detection at a lowered `detect_threshold` shows as
    /// `detected` even when the native class stays `safe`, and its `layers`
    /// are the L1 model's. An L2 or L3 result keeps its layer in its own
    /// `layers`. The synchronous `scan_*` reports move it to the report's
    /// `decision` list, once per module.
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub module_decision: Option<crate::ModuleDecision>,
}
```

Public scan result returned by `SecurityGateway` methods: Core's
[`patronus_ark_core::NativeResult`] (category, class, confidence, level,
model, layers, evidence, label scores, decision envelope) plus what only
the layered gateway reports. It dereferences to the Core result.

## Synchronous Core API

```rust
pub struct ScannerConfig {
    /// Native text-scan categories: `pii`, `dlp` and the eleven attack classes.
    pub categories: Vec<SecurityCategory>,
    /// Deepest layer that may run. Default: `L3`.
    pub max_level: SecurityLevel,
    /// The gates: rules, models, `<category>_mode`, `explain`, the level
    /// switches `l1`, `l2`, `l3`, `conditional` (result conditions; Core
    /// scans carry no request metadata), the opt-in `cascade` and Ark's L3
    /// worker policy `l3_policy`. Their keys sit at the top level of the
    /// config.
    ///
    /// The levels run the same way with or without a cascade: L1 (the
    /// native producers and L1 models) unless switched off, Wolf (the
    /// injection L3) up to `max_level` unless switched off. With a cascade
    /// (see [`crate::cascade::CascadeConfig`]), Wolf runs only where the
    /// cascade escalates, conditional gates apply, and
    /// [`ScanReport::decision`] reports each scanned module's final answer.
    #[serde(flatten)]
    pub gates: ScanGateMatrix,
    /// Maximum UTF-8 input size; exceeding it is an error. Default: unset
    /// (no limit).
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub max_input_bytes: Option<usize>,
    /// Maximum actionable evidence spans; more are an error, reports are
    /// never silently truncated. Default: unset (no limit).
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub max_findings: Option<usize>,
    /// Model cache root of the bundles a config does not place with its own
    /// `bundle_dir`. Default: [`crate::warmup::default_cache_root`].
    pub cache_root: Option<PathBuf>,
    /// Whether warmup may download missing model files: `never` (the
    /// default) or `missing`. Scans never download.
    pub download: DownloadPolicy,
    /// The categories whose model files may download (Wolf's is `injection`,
    /// Cat's `shell_command`); unset: every category.
    pub download_categories: Option<Vec<SecurityCategory>>,
    /// Budget for asset lock waiting, downloads and retries, not model
    /// construction. Default: 600000.
    pub download_timeout_ms: u64,
    /// ONNX execution backend of every ONNX model (Wolf and the host's own):
    /// `auto` (default), `cpu`, `gpu`, `coreml`, `cuda`, `directml`, `tensorrt`.
    #[cfg(feature = "wolf")]
    pub execution_backend: crate::ExecutionBackend,
    /// ONNX Runtime session options of every ONNX model.
    #[cfg(feature = "wolf")]
    pub onnx_runtime: crate::OnnxRuntimeOptions,
    #[cfg(feature = "wolf")]
    pub wolf: Option<crate::wolf::WolfConfig>,
    /// Cat, the shell-command verdict; see [`Scanner::shell_verdict`].
    pub shell: Option<ShellConfig>,
}
```

Queue-free scanner policy. Defaults to pii, dlp and the core attack classes
(injection, jailbreak, prompt_extraction, tool_poisoning, exfiltration), no
Wolf and no Cat. Unknown keys are refused (by the gate keys, which take
every key the scanner does not name).

Ark's gateway config is this config plus Ark's own keys: every key here
means the same in Ark.

```rust
pub fn resolved(&self) -> Result<Self, ScanError>;
```

This config with every bundle directory set: a bundle without its own
`bundle_dir` lives below the model cache root.

```rust
pub fn warmup_options(&self) -> WarmupOptions;
```

The download keys, which warmup applies per category.

```rust
pub enum ScanError {
    #[error("invalid scanner configuration: {0}")]
    Config(String),
    #[error("input exceeds {limit} bytes")]
    InputLimit { limit: usize },
    #[error("findings exceed {limit}")]
    FindingLimit { limit: usize },
    #[error("native detector failed: {0}")]
    Detector(String),
    #[error("scan cancelled")]
    Cancelled,
    #[error("scan deadline exceeded")]
    DeadlineExceeded,
    #[error("asset error: {0}")]
    Asset(String),
    #[error("Wolf inference failed: {0}")]
    Inference(String),
    #[error("shell verdict failed: {0}")]
    Shell(String),
}
```

```rust
pub struct ScanReport<R = NativeResult> {
    pub input_bytes: usize,
    pub native: Vec<R>,
    /// Wolf's result when it ran. Without a cascade Wolf runs on every scan
    /// that selects `injection`, as before. `None` when Wolf is not
    /// configured, when `injection` was not selected, or, with a configured
    /// cascade, when the cascade did not escalate the injection module to L3
    /// (its L1 decided the input, L3 is above `cascade.max_level` or switched
    /// off, or a conditional gate kept it off).
    #[cfg(feature = "wolf")]
    pub wolf: Option<crate::wolf::WolfResult>,
    /// Final answer and deciding stage per scanned module; set when
    /// [`ScannerConfig::cascade`] is configured. A module no stage ran for
    /// (L1 switched off and no later layer answered) has no entry.
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub decision: Option<Vec<ModuleDecision>>,
}
```

Complete scan output; native decisions and model probabilities remain separate.

`R` is the per-category result: Core's [`NativeResult`]; Ark's gateway
reports its own result type, which embeds `NativeResult`, in the same envelope.

## Shared Native Engine

```rust
pub struct NativeProducerOutcome {
    pub detection: NativeDetection,
    pub duration_ms: f64,
}
```

Raw producer output; result/decision mapping remains the host's responsibility.

```rust
pub struct NativeEngine {
    groups: [Vec<NativeProducerSpec>; NATIVE_CATEGORIES.len()],
}
```

Owns each selected category's detector state once, without worker threads.

```rust
pub fn new(categories: &[SecurityCategory]) -> Self;
```

Initialize only configured native categories; other categories have no
native producers. An empty selection creates no pipelines.

```rust
pub fn prepare(&self, gates: &ScanGateMatrix);
```

Builds what a scan under `gates` runs, for every enabled producer:
rules and pipelines are built on first use, so the ones the gates
keep off cost no memory. Call it when the gates are fixed (a scanner's
config, a gateway's execution gates) so that no scan under them
builds anything; a scan under other gates builds what they enable on
first use. What is built stays, also after a gate change turns it off.

```rust
pub fn producers(&self, category: SecurityCategory) -> &[NativeProducerSpec];
```

Producers in the established category order, or empty for an unselected
or non-native category.

```rust
pub fn runs(&self, category: SecurityCategory, gates: &ScanGateMatrix) -> bool;
```

Whether `gates` enable one of the producers of `category`: its L1
pass runs ([`Self::scan_module`]).

```rust
pub fn run_producer(
    &self,
    producer: &NativeProducerSpec,
    prepared: &NativeText<'_>,
    gates: &ScanGateMatrix,
    control: &ScanControl,
) -> Result<NativeProducerOutcome, ScanError>;
```

Execute an active producer. Call `producer.enabled(gates)` before this method.
Cancellation is checked before and after detection; panics become detector errors.

```rust
pub fn scan_module(
    &self,
    category: SecurityCategory,
    prepared: &NativeText<'_>,
    gates: &ScanGateMatrix,
    control: &ScanControl,
) -> Result<Vec<NativeResult>, ScanError>;
```

The L1 pass of one module, shared by the Core [`crate::Scanner`] and
Ark's gateway: every producer of `category` that `gates` enable, its
evidence filtered by post-prediction, and the `ark.injection.*`
producers merged into one scored decision
([`crate::injection_l1::category_results`]). A failing producer
reports an `error` result ([`NativeResult::scanner_error`]);
cancellation and an exceeded deadline are returned as errors.

## Wolf Execution Options

```rust
pub struct WolfExecutionOptions {
    /// Maximum sequence length, including BOS and EOS; unset takes the bundle's window.
    pub window_tokens: Option<usize>,

    pub overlap_tokens: Option<usize>,

}
```

Wolf document execution. Sizes count tokens, batches count document windows.

Defender publishes 2048-token windows with 64 overlap).

```rust
}
```

A named Wolf serving choice: the window sizes it fills in where the options leave
them unset, and its decision rule. Core's defaults stay the model's published
settings; a caller that serves Wolf differently selects a profile here.


`options` with this profile's sizes where they are unset.

Whether `probability` detects at `threshold` under this profile's rule.

```rust
pub enum SecurityCategory {
    /// Prompt injection and instruction hierarchy attacks.
    Injection,
    /// Data-loss-prevention checks for secrets and sensitive material.
    Dlp,
    /// Personally identifiable information checks.
    Pii,
    /// Dynamic zero-shot entity extraction in the L3 worker.
    DynamicPii,
    /// Sensitive document classification.
    SensitiveDocument,
    /// Tool type classification.
    ToolClass,
    /// Tool operation classification.
    ToolAction,
    /// Multi-label tool source and sink tags.
    ToolTags,
    /// Operational request routing.
    Routing,
    /// Jailbreak techniques that bypass safety rules.
    Jailbreak,
    /// Requests to reveal hidden instructions, tool schemas or rules.
    PromptExtraction,
    /// Instructions hidden in tool or MCP descriptions, schemas and agent cards.
    ToolPoisoning,
    /// Malicious instructions in skills, rules files, agent configuration or hooks.
    AgentConfigTampering,
    /// Content that tries to write itself into long-term memory or a profile.
    MemoryPoisoning,
    /// Data sent to external sinks (markdown/URL, DNS, tool parameters, webhooks).
    Exfiltration,
    /// Requests for destructive, executing, privilege-widening or control-disabling actions.
    UnsafeAction,
    /// Endless loops, recursive spawning and cost explosions.
    ResourceExhaustion,
    /// Requests for dangerous content.
    HarmfulContent,
    /// Hate, harassment, threats, insults and profanity.
    ToxicLanguage,
    /// Risk scoring for shell commands and scripts (POSIX, PowerShell, CMD).
    ShellCommand,
}
```

```rust
pub struct NativeResult {
    /// Category that was scanned, for example `injection` or `dlp`.
    pub category: String,
    /// Stable class label for the final decision.
    pub class_name: String,
    /// Final confidence score in the inclusive range `0.0..=1.0` when available.
    pub confidence: f64,
    /// Highest layer that contributed the final decision.
    pub level: String,
    /// Model or native scanner name that produced the final decision.
    pub model: String,
    /// Sum of recorded layer durations, in milliseconds.
    pub duration_ms: f64,
    /// Ordered layer evidence that explains the final decision.
    pub layers: Vec<LayerResult>,
    /// Exact entity evidence returned by span-producing pipelines.
    pub evidence_spans: Vec<EvidenceSpan>,
    /// Per-label scores for multi-label classifier outputs.
    pub label_scores: Vec<LabelScore>,
    /// Structured classifier decision contract for policy consumers; omitted
    /// from the serialized result while unset.
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub decision: Option<DecisionEnvelope>,
}
```

```rust
pub enum ExecutionBackend {
    /// Keep conservative CPU defaults unless a caller overrides execution mode.
    #[default]
    Auto,
    /// CPU execution: prefer lazy L3 execution and low concurrency.
    Cpu,
    /// Platform GPU alias: DirectML on Windows, CUDA on Linux, unsupported on macOS.
    Gpu,
    /// CoreML execution provider.
    #[serde(rename = "coreml", alias = "core_ml")]
    CoreMl,
    /// CUDA execution provider.
    Cuda,
    /// DirectML execution provider.
    #[serde(rename = "directml", alias = "direct_ml")]
    DirectMl,
    /// TensorRT execution provider.
    #[serde(rename = "tensorrt", alias = "tensor_rt")]
    TensorRt,
}
```

## Wolf Defender Runtime

```rust
pub struct WolfConfig {
    /// The model's bundle directory; unset takes the model's directory below
    /// the model cache root ([`crate::warmup::wolf_bundle_dir`]).
    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub bundle_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
    /// Attack-probability threshold; unset takes the bundle's published one.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub threshold: Option<f64>,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub model: WolfModel,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub precision: WolfPrecision,
    /// Document windows and batching; unset sizes follow the bundle.
    #[serde(default)]
    pub execution: WolfExecutionOptions,
}
```

The Wolf Defender L3 of the injection module: model size, precision,
bundle, document windows and the attack-probability threshold it
detects at. Everything unset follows the bundle's published settings
(`POOLING.json`): Wolf Defender detects strictly above 0.5 over
2048-token windows with 64 overlap.

```rust
pub struct PipelineModelAssetSpec {
    /// Scanner category that owns this pipeline model.

}
```

A revision-pinned model bundle used by a standalone pipeline.

The bundle files this process loads: the fp16 graph replaces the quantized one
when `PATRONUS_L3_PRECISION=fp16` and the bundle has one.

```rust
    generate: bool,
    progress: Option<&SecurityAssetProgressCallback>,
```

Prepare the selected bundle files below the model cache `root` with Core's

## Asset Download Helpers

```rust
pub fn ntdb_l2_package_current(spec: &ModelSpec, root: &Path) -> bool;
```

Whether the NTDB L2 package `spec` below the model cache `root` is the
complete pinned revision: its manifest valid, its embedding matrix of the
manifest's shape and an L3-compatible tokenizer the unified L3's.

```rust
pub fn prepare_ntdb_l2_package(
    spec: &ModelSpec,
    category: SecurityCategory,
    root: &Path,
    download: DownloadPolicy,
    progress: Option<&SecurityAssetProgressCallback>,
) -> Result<PathBuf, ScanError>;
```

Prepare the NTDB L2 package `spec` of `category` below the model cache
`root` with Core's [`ModelSpec::prepare_package`]: the manifest first,
then the runtime files it lists; the shared embedder files go to their
shared cache directory (fetched again when stale) and are linked into the
package. Under [`DownloadPolicy::Never`] a missing or stale file fails.

```rust
pub fn ntdb_l2_package_manifest_files(
    manifest_json: &str,
) -> Result<Vec<String>, Box<dyn std::error::Error>>;
```

Return all runtime files referenced by an NTDB v4 package manifest.
